oneLine: 将雷达脉冲与参考样本的相似性转化为结构化脉冲时序输入，在噪声干扰下同时服务去噪与辐射源识别。
coreClaim: 相似性分布比单个脉冲特征更能表达真实脉冲与噪声脉冲之间的结构差异。
problem: 高密度多源雷达环境中，PDW 序列常被噪声和干扰污染，单脉冲特征在时频域高度重叠，传统阈值或规则方法难以兼顾鲁棒性、实时性与边缘部署。
method: SGTE 将 pulse-to-reference similarity 离散为直方图向量，并通过概率编码或可学习嵌入生成脉冲时序；理论上利用真实脉冲与噪声脉冲相似性分布的差异保持可分性，再由 SNN 完成去噪与识别。
whyItMatters: 这项工作把雷达信号处理中的相似性结构转化为 SNN 擅长处理的时间事件序列，为边缘端低功耗雷达智能提供了更自然的输入形式。

pipeline.text: 从复杂雷达场景中接收带噪脉冲描述字序列。

pipeline.label: Similarity histogram
pipeline.text: 计算脉冲与参考样本的相似性并形成分布化表示。

pipeline.text: 完成脉冲去噪和辐射源识别，并保留事件驱动效率。

用相似性分布距离说明真实/噪声脉冲的可分性。
面向低功耗事件驱动计算平台。

highlights: 提出相似性引导的时间编码，将连续相似性结构映射为 SNN 可处理的 spike train。
从连续域分布距离出发分析真实脉冲与噪声脉冲的可分性，并连接到离散脉冲表示。
在多源雷达数据和不同骨干网络上验证去噪与识别效果，强调低功耗事件驱动部署潜力。
discussion: 适合作为“雷达信号如何进入 SNN”的入口论文阅读：先看相似性分布，再看编码方式，最后看去噪与识别性能。

en.oneLine: SGTE converts pulse-to-reference similarities into structured temporal spike inputs for joint radar pulse denoising and emitter recognition.
en.coreClaim: Similarity distributions capture structural differences between genuine and noisy pulses better than isolated pulse features.
en.problem: In dense multi-source radar environments, PDW sequences are corrupted by noise and interference. Single-pulse features overlap in time-frequency domains, making threshold or rule-based methods fragile under real-time and edge constraints.
en.method: SGTE discretizes pulse-to-reference similarities into histogram representations and generates spike trains through probabilistic coding or learnable embeddings. Theoretical analysis connects distributional separability to effective SNN discrimination.
en.whyItMatters: The work transforms radar similarity structure into the temporal event representation that SNNs naturally process, offering an input pathway for low-power radar intelligence.

pipeline.text: Receive noisy pulse descriptor words from complex radar scenes.

pipeline.label: Similarity histogram
pipeline.text: Compare pulses with references and build distributional representations.

pipeline.label: Temporal encoding
pipeline.text: Generate structured spike trains via probabilistic coding or learned embeddings.

pipeline.label: SNN inference
pipeline.text: Perform denoising and emitter recognition with event-driven efficiency.

Distributional distance explains genuine/noise pulse separability.
Designed for low-power event-driven platforms.

highlights: Proposes similarity-guided temporal encoding from continuous similarity structure to spike trains.
Analyzes separability from distributional distance and connects it to discrete spike representations.
Evaluates denoising and recognition across multi-source radar data and different backbones.
en.discussion: A good entry point for understanding how radar signals can be represented for SNNs: read similarity distributions first, then encoding, then denoising and recognition results.

oneLine: 把自组织映射的无监督聚类过程放进脉冲域，用 BMU 放电率完成雷达脉冲序列去交织。
coreClaim: SOM 的拓扑保持能力可以与 SNN 的事件驱动稀疏计算结合，形成低功耗无监督去交织框架。
problem: 复杂电磁环境下的雷达信号去交织需要在未知标签、高密度脉冲和边缘算力受限之间取得平衡，传统 SOM 又依赖连续域距离计算。
method: Spiking-SOM 用 LIF 神经元表示 SOM 节点，输入 PDW 被编码为稀疏脉冲张量，BMU 由神经元平均放电率选择；权重更新在脉冲域完成，并用 Robbins-Monro 条件讨论收敛与拓扑稳定性。
whyItMatters: 该方法让无监督雷达分选不再完全依赖密集浮点距离计算，更适合部署在 FPGA 或类脑硬件等边缘平台。

计算与访存随输入稀疏度下降。

highlights: 将 SOM 的 BMU 选择和邻域更新迁移到 spike domain，减少显式浮点距离计算。
给出 BMU 放电率单调性和权重更新收敛条件，为无监督 SNN 聚类提供理论支撑。
面向 FPGA 等边缘硬件，利用事件驱动累积和稀疏更新降低计算与访存。
discussion: 这篇论文适合和 SGTE-SNN 对照阅读：前者关注有监督/任务驱动编码，本文关注无监督拓扑组织。

en.oneLine: Spiking-SOM moves self-organizing-map clustering into the spike domain and uses BMU firing rates for unsupervised radar pulse deinterleaving.
en.coreClaim: SOM topology preservation can be combined with event-driven sparse SNN computation to support low-power unsupervised deinterleaving.
en.problem: Radar deinterleaving must handle unknown labels, dense pulses, and limited edge computation, while conventional SOMs rely on continuous-domain distance computation.
en.method: Spiking-SOM represents SOM units with LIF neurons, encodes PDW inputs as sparse spike tensors, selects BMUs by average firing rate, and updates weights in the spike domain with convergence analysis based on Robbins-Monro conditions.
en.whyItMatters: The method reduces reliance on dense floating-point distance computation and is more compatible with FPGA or neuromorphic edge platforms.

pipeline.text: Encode PDW features into sparse temporal spike tensors.

pipeline.label: Neuron response
pipeline.text: Accumulate membrane potential and firing responses in LIF units.

pipeline.label: BMU selection
pipeline.text: Select the best matching unit by average firing rate.

BMU monotonicity and Robbins-Monro conditions.
Arithmetic and memory access decrease with input sparsity.

highlights: Moves BMU selection and neighborhood update from SOM to the spike domain.
Provides monotonic firing-rate and convergence analysis for unsupervised SNN clustering.
Targets edge radar processing through event-driven accumulation and sparse updates.
en.discussion: Read it together with SGTE-SNN: SGTE focuses on task-driven encoding, while this paper focuses on unsupervised topological organization.

oneLine: 根据膜电位分布动态调节替代梯度函数，让 SNN 训练中的梯度传播更稳定、更高效。
coreClaim: 替代梯度函数的有效宽度应当和膜电位统计动态匹配，而不是使用固定的全局形状。
problem: SNN 直接训练常受非可微放电函数、膜电位漂移和时间离散误差影响，固定形状的替代梯度容易与真实神经活动分布错配。
method: MPO 用 KL 散度约束膜电位分布，引入自适应宽度约束使替代梯度作用范围与膜电位统计同步，并设计离散化误差度量与校正策略来改善长时序梯度传播。
whyItMatters: 这项工作把替代函数设计从经验超参数推进到和神经动力学统计耦合的优化问题，提升了 SNN 训练可解释性。

highlights: 从理论上分析替代梯度宽度和膜电位分布错配如何压缩有效优化区域。
提出膜电位引导的替代函数优化框架，联合稳定神经动力学与梯度范围。
在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 上分别达到 94.76%、74.20% 和 65.70% top-1 accuracy。
discussion: 阅读时可以抓住一条线：膜电位分布决定梯度是否有效，替代函数需要跟着分布变化，而不是静态固定。

en.oneLine: MPO dynamically adjusts surrogate gradients according to membrane potential distributions for more stable and efficient SNN training.
en.coreClaim: The effective width of surrogate gradients should match membrane potential statistics dynamically instead of being fixed globally.
en.problem: Direct SNN training is affected by non-differentiable spikes, membrane potential drift, and temporal discretization errors. Fixed surrogate functions can easily mismatch neural activity distributions.
en.method: MPO regularizes membrane potential distributions with KL divergence, aligns surrogate width with membrane statistics, and introduces a discretization-error metric with correction to improve temporal gradient propagation.
en.whyItMatters: It reframes surrogate-function design from empirical hyperparameter tuning to a dynamics-aware optimization problem.

pipeline.text: Use KL divergence to stabilize membrane dynamics.

oneLine: 用自适应聚类生成伪标签，再用相似性学习判断簇间关系，提升复杂场景雷达信号分选鲁棒性。
coreClaim: 雷达信号分选可以先用聚类形成弱标签，再用相似性网络修正簇级关系，从而降低标注依赖。
problem: 雷达信号分选在高密度、强交织和多场景数据分布变化下容易退化，完全监督深度模型又依赖大量标注数据。
method: ACSL 先在 RF、PW、DOA 等特征空间中进行动态分区与自适应缩放，生成并优化伪标签；随后用双分支相似性学习网络结合 PRI 与特征差异判断不同簇是否来自同一雷达。
whyItMatters: 这套流程把无监督聚类、PRI 信息和深度相似性判别组合起来，更贴近真实电子侦察中标签稀缺和场景变化的问题。

en.oneLine: ACSL combines adaptive clustering for pseudo-label generation with similarity learning to improve radar signal sorting in complex scenes.
en.coreClaim: Radar signal sorting can use clustering to form weak labels and a similarity network to refine cluster-level relationships.
en.problem: Radar signal sorting degrades under high density, strong interleaving, and multi-scenario distribution shifts, while fully supervised deep models require large labeled datasets.
en.method: ACSL partitions RF, PW, and DOA feature spaces with adaptive scaling to generate pseudo-labels, then uses a dual-branch similarity network with PRI and feature differences to decide whether clusters originate from the same radar.
en.whyItMatters: The pipeline combines unsupervised clustering, PRI knowledge, and deep similarity judgment, matching label scarcity and scenario variation in real reconnaissance tasks.

pipeline.label: Feature partition
pipeline.text: Dynamically partition PDW streams by RF, PW, and DOA.

pipeline.label: Pseudo labels
pipeline.text: Generate initial clusters through adaptive clustering and scaling.

pipeline.label: PRI relation
pipeline.text: Compute PRI and feature differences between clusters.

pipeline.label: Similarity network
pipeline.text: Decide whether clusters should be merged as the same radar source.

evidence.note: Reduces reliance on large labeled datasets.
Targets distribution shifts across radar scenes.
Produces deinterleaved radar pulse clusters.

highlights: Uses adaptive scaling to reduce distribution differences across sub-blocks and scenes.
Combines pseudo-label optimization with similarity learning.
Addresses accuracy, purity, robustness, and computation time in radar signal sorting.
en.discussion: A useful template for weakly supervised radar sorting: read it through pseudo-label quality and cluster-merge decisions.

oneLine: 用长短时间步双模型互蒸馏缓解 SNN 降低推理时间步时的精度损失。
coreClaim: 低延迟 SNN 不应孤立训练，短时间步模型可以通过长时间步模型的知识迁移保持信息表达。
problem: 遥感图像分类对边缘端低功耗和实时性要求很高，但 SNN 往往需要较长时间步才能保持充分信息表达，短时间步会带来精度下降。
method: Long-Short Step Dual-Model Mutual Distillation 让长步模型与短步模型协同训练并相互蒸馏，同时用平滑随机时间步机制逐步降低短步模型时间步，减轻低延迟训练的信息损失。
whyItMatters: 遥感边缘部署需要同时考虑能耗、延迟和精度，该框架给出了降低 SNN 时间步时保持性能的一种训练策略。

pipeline.label: Long-step SNN
pipeline.text: 保持更充分的时序信息表达。

pipeline.label: Short-step SNN
pipeline.text: 面向低延迟推理约束。

pipeline.label: Mutual distillation
pipeline.text: 长短模型在训练中共享知识和判别信息。

pipeline.label: Smooth timestep
pipeline.text: 平滑降低短步模型时间步，避免训练突变。

evidence.note: 面向遥感图像低功耗分类。
双模型覆盖精度与低延迟需求。
相同时间步下相比单模型减少约 3% 精度损失。

highlights: 用双模型互蒸馏让短时间步 SNN 从长时间步模型中获得更稳定的表示。
提出 smooth random time step 机制，平滑缩短时间步而不是突然压缩时序信息。
在 MSTAR、UCM、SIRI-WHU 等遥感数据集上，相同时间步下相比单模型减少约 3% 的精度损失。
discussion: 可把这篇论文作为 SNN 低延迟训练的案例：不是只改网络结构，而是通过训练机制降低时间步依赖。

en.oneLine: A long-short step dual-model mutual distillation framework reduces accuracy loss when SNN inference timesteps are shortened.
en.coreClaim: Low-latency SNNs should not be trained in isolation; short-step models can preserve information through knowledge transfer from long-step models.
en.problem: Remote sensing classification needs low power and real-time inference, but SNNs often require longer timesteps for sufficient information representation.
en.method: The framework trains long-step and short-step SNNs collaboratively with mutual distillation, while a smooth random timestep mechanism gradually reduces the short-step model's timesteps.
en.whyItMatters: Edge remote sensing requires energy, latency, and accuracy trade-offs. This training strategy maintains performance while reducing SNN timesteps.

evidence.note: Low-power image classification.
Covers accuracy and latency needs.
Nearly 3% reduction compared with a single model under the same timestep.

highlights: Uses mutual distillation so short-step SNNs learn stable representations from long-step models.
Introduces smooth random timestep reduction.
Evaluates on MSTAR, UCM, and SIRI-WHU.
en.discussion: A case study in low-latency SNN training: reduce timestep dependency through training design, not only architecture.

oneLine: 将 CNN 预测模型与遗传算法结合，用 TCAD 数据驱动多浮空埋层 LDMOS 的击穿电压优化。
coreClaim: 复杂功率器件结构的参数搜索可以由 TCAD 数据和机器学习代理模型显著加速。
problem: 多浮空埋层 LDMOS 参数耦合强、结构复杂，传统物理推导与手工扫描难以高效探索最优击穿电压设计空间。
method: 研究先用 TCAD 生成结构参数与 BV 数据集，再训练 CNN 预测模型；随后把预测模型作为遗传算法适应度评估器，自适应搜索最优结构参数，并用 TCAD 回验。
whyItMatters: 该路线展示了器件物理与 AI 优化结合的范式：用仿真数据建立代理模型，再把搜索成本从大量 TCAD 仿真转移到快速预测。

CNN 模型用于快速预测 MFBL LDMOS 的 BV，降低反复仿真的搜索成本。

discussion: 阅读重点是“代理模型 + 全局搜索 + 仿真回验”的闭环，而不是单一模型结构。

en.oneLine: This work combines a CNN surrogate and genetic algorithm to optimize breakdown voltage for MFBL LDMOS using TCAD data.
en.coreClaim: Parameter search for complex power device structures can be accelerated by TCAD data and ML surrogate models.
en.problem: MFBL LDMOS has strongly coupled parameters and complex structures, making traditional derivation or manual sweeps inefficient for BV optimization.
en.method: The work generates a TCAD dataset of structural parameters and BV, trains a CNN predictor, uses it as the fitness evaluator in a genetic algorithm, and validates optimized structures with TCAD.
en.whyItMatters: It demonstrates a device-physics + AI optimization workflow: train a surrogate with simulation data and shift search cost from TCAD sweeps to fast prediction.

oneLine: 面向 SIPOS 调制漂移区 U-MOSFET，建立结合物理解析与 GPR 的 FOM 预测模型。
coreClaim: 物理解析模型和高斯过程回归可以共同刻画 BV-RON,sp 折中，并保留可解释的器件参数关系。
problem: 超结 U-MOSFET 的 BV-RON,sp 折中受电场调制、charge coupling 和结构参数共同影响，单纯解析模型难以兼顾可解释性和预测精度。
method: 论文先基于 Poisson 方程构建物理解析表达，再使用 Gaussian Process Regression 预测 FOM = BV²/RON,sp 并优化超参数，最后结合 TCAD 验证结构参数和性能边界。
whyItMatters: 相比纯黑箱建模，这类 physics-informed ML 更适合器件研究，因为它同时给出性能预测和结构参数解释。

highlights: 把 SIPOS 柱引入超结 U-MOSFET 漂移区调制，讨论突破 SJ silicon limit 的 BV-RON,sp 折中。
用 GPR 校准解析模型参数，兼顾物理含义、预测精度和可解释优化。

discussion: 这篇适合关注 physics-informed ML 的读者：它不是只用数据拟合，而是用数据修正具有物理结构的模型。

en.oneLine: A physics-informed FOM model for SIPOS-modulated U-MOSFET combines analytical device modeling with Gaussian process regression.
en.coreClaim: Analytical physics and GPR can jointly model BV-RON,sp trade-offs while preserving interpretable device-parameter relationships.
en.problem: The BV-RON,sp trade-off in SJ U-MOSFETs is influenced by electric-field modulation, charge coupling, and structural parameters; pure analytical models struggle to balance interpretability and accuracy.
en.method: The paper builds analytical expressions from Poisson's equation, uses GPR to predict FOM = BV²/RON,sp and tune parameters, and validates trends with TCAD.
en.whyItMatters: Physics-informed ML is useful for device research because it provides both performance prediction and interpretable parameter relationships.

oneLine: 提出 variable-K 高介电常数沟槽调制 SJ-LDMOS 体电场，提高击穿电压并保持导通和散热特性。
coreClaim: 沿沟槽深度改变介电常数可以重新塑造 SJ-LDMOS 纵向体电场，从而提高 BV。
problem: 传统 SJ-LDMOS 在长漂移区下受漏端曲率效应和体电场不均匀限制，击穿电压容易饱和，难以接近理论电压承受能力。
method: 在 N+ drain 下引入上下介电常数不同的 VHK dielectric trench，上部高 K 区通过 dielectric RESURF 抑制漏端高场峰值，下部较低 K 区扩展衬底耗尽并重新分布纵向体电场。
whyItMatters: 这项工作展示了通过介质工程调控体电场的器件设计思路，为高压功率器件结构优化提供了可解释路径。

同时讨论最佳介电常数范围、导通特性、热特性和可行工艺流程。
discussion: 这篇论文是器件物理线的基础工作，适合用来理解后续机器学习辅助器件建模中的结构参数和性能指标。

en.oneLine: A variable-K dielectric trench modulates the bulk electric field of SJ-LDMOS to improve breakdown voltage while maintaining conduction and thermal behavior.
en.coreClaim: Varying dielectric permittivity along trench depth reshapes the vertical bulk electric field and improves BV.
en.problem: Conventional SJ-LDMOS suffers from drain curvature effects and non-uniform bulk electric fields, causing BV saturation in long drift regions.
en.method: The device introduces a VHK dielectric trench under the N+ drain. The upper high-K region suppresses drain-side E-field peaks through dielectric RESURF, while the lower-K region expands substrate depletion and redistributes vertical bulk fields.
en.whyItMatters: It shows an interpretable device-design route: modulate electric fields through dielectric engineering to optimize high-voltage power devices.

en.discussion: This is a foundational device-physics paper for understanding later ML-assisted device modeling work.
